name: codepulse-vscode
description: Local-first, agent-native code intelligence for VS Code — search, symbol navigation, references, and impact analysis, powered by a local CodePulse server.

codepulse.serverUrl.description: Base URL of the CodePulse REST API server.

codepulse.autoLaunchServer.description: If no CodePulse server is reachable when a workspace opens, offer to launch one locally (`codepulse serve`).

codepulse.serverCommand.description: Command used to launch the local CodePulse server. Must be on PATH, or an absolute path to the codepulse executable.
